```{r}
# ==== CONFIG ====

DATA_PATH    <- "/Users/ianbarbero/Downloads/Crash_Data_Cleaned_v3.csv"   # <— set your path
TARGET_HUMAN <- "Driver At Fault"                                    # as it appears in CSV
POS_CLASS    <- "Yes"                                                # positive class label
SEED         <- 180

# Optional sampling to speed up iteration (set to NA for full data)

SAMPLE_N     <- 20000

# ==== PACKAGES ====

pkgs <- c("tidyverse","janitor","readr","forcats",
"caret","ranger","pROC","yardstick","ggplot2")
need <- pkgs[!sapply(pkgs, require, character.only = TRUE)]
if (length(need)) {
try(install.packages(need), silent = TRUE)
lapply(need, require, character.only = TRUE)
}
set.seed(SEED)

# ==== HELPERS ====

normalize <- function(x) gsub("[^a-z0-9]+","",tolower(x))
find_col <- function(df, human_name){
key <- normalize(human_name)
nm  <- names(df)
hit <- nm[normalize(nm) == key]
if (length(hit)) return(hit[1])
hit2 <- nm[grepl(key, normalize(nm), fixed=TRUE)]
if (length(hit2)) return(hit2[1])
stop("Couldn't find a column like: ", human_name)
}

# collapse rare factor levels to reduce dimensionality

collapse_levels <- function(f, min_n = 200) {
if (!is.factor(f)) f <- factor(f)
tab  <- table(f)
keep <- names(tab[tab >= min_n])
f2   <- ifelse(f %in% keep, as.character(f), "Other")
factor(f2)
}

# robust AUC: tries both ROC directions and returns the larger

robust_auc <- function(truth_factor, pos_scores) {
lv <- levels(truth_factor); stopifnot(length(lv) == 2)
roc_lt <- pROC::roc(response = truth_factor, predictor = pos_scores,
levels = lv, direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
roc_gt <- pROC::roc(response = truth_factor, predictor = pos_scores,
levels = lv, direction = ">", quiet = TRUE)
auc_lt <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_lt)); auc_gt <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_gt))
if (auc_lt >= auc_gt) list(auc = auc_lt, roc = roc_lt) else list(auc = auc_gt, roc = roc_gt)
}



```

```{r}
raw <- readr::read_csv(DATA_PATH, guess_max = 200000)
df  <- janitor::clean_names(raw)

TARGET <- find_col(df, TARGET_HUMAN)

# keep rows with target present; factor & put positive first if present

df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[TARGET]]))
if (!is.factor(df[[TARGET]])) df[[TARGET]] <- as.factor(df[[TARGET]])
if (POS_CLASS %in% levels(df[[TARGET]])) {
df[[TARGET]] <- forcats::fct_relevel(df[[TARGET]], POS_CLASS)
}

# if target has an 'Unknown' level, drop it to keep binary ROC setup

if ("Unknown" %in% levels(df[[TARGET]])) {
df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[TARGET]] != "Unknown") %>% droplevels()
}

cat("Rows:", nrow(df), " Cols:", ncol(df), "\n")
cat("Target:", TARGET, " Levels:", paste(levels(df[[TARGET]]), collapse=", "), "\n")



```

```{r}
# numeric: median impute; character: ""→NA; NA→"Unknown"; then cast to factor

df <- df %>%
mutate(across(where(is.character), ~na_if(.x, ""))) %>%
mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ifelse(is.na(.), median(., na.rm=TRUE), .))) %>%
mutate(across(where(is.character), ~tidyr::replace_na(.x, "Unknown"))) %>%
mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))



```


```{r}
# 1) Optional stratified sample (keeps class balance)

if (!is.na(SAMPLE_N) && nrow(df) > SAMPLE_N) {
idx <- caret::createDataPartition(df[[TARGET]], p = SAMPLE_N / nrow(df), list = FALSE)
df  <- df[idx, ]
cat("Sampled to:", nrow(df), "rows\n")
}

# 2) Collapse rare factor levels globally (min_n can be tuned)

df <- df %>% mutate(across(where(is.factor), collapse_levels, min_n = 200))

# 3) Drop near-zero-variance predictors (on features only)

nzv <- caret::nearZeroVar(df %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(TARGET)), saveMetrics = TRUE)
drop_cols <- rownames(nzv)[nzv$nzv]
if (length(drop_cols)) {
df <- df %>% dplyr::select(-any_of(drop_cols))
cat("Dropped NZV cols:", length(drop_cols), "\n")
}



```

```{r}
set.seed(SEED)
idx   <- caret::createDataPartition(df[[TARGET]], p = 0.80, list = FALSE)
train <- df[idx, ]
test  <- df[-idx, ]

cat("Train:", nrow(train), " Test:", nrow(test), "\n")



```

```{r}
# ----- XGBoost (direct) replace caret training + eval -----

library(xgboost)
library(Matrix)  # for sparse matrix if needed


TARGET_COL <- TARGET
y_train <- ifelse(train[[TARGET_COL]] == levels(train[[TARGET_COL]])[1], 1L, 0L)
y_test  <- ifelse(test[[TARGET_COL]]  == levels(train[[TARGET_COL]])[1], 1L, 0L)


train_X_df <- train %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(TARGET_COL))
test_X_df  <- test  %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(TARGET_COL))


mm_train <- model.matrix(~ . -1, data = train_X_df)
mm_test  <- model.matrix(~ . -1, data = test_X_df)


dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = mm_train, label = y_train)
dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = mm_test,  label = y_test)


params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "auc",
  max_depth = 6,
  eta = 0.30,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8
)

nrounds <- 100
watchlist <- list(train = dtrain, eval = dtest)

set.seed(SEED)
bst <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = nrounds,
  watchlist = watchlist,
  verbose = 0,
  nthread = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
)

# 4) Predictions and metrics (keeps same metric calculations as your notebook)
prob_xgb <- predict(bst, dtest)              # probabilities for positive class (1)
pred_xgb_bin <- ifelse(prob_xgb >= 0.5, 1L, 0L)

# Map numeric predictions back to factor levels used earlier (pos level is first factor level)
pos_lvl <- levels(train[[TARGET]])[1]
neg_lvl <- levels(train[[TARGET]])[2]
pred_xgb <- factor(ifelse(pred_xgb_bin == 1, pos_lvl, neg_lvl), levels = c(pos_lvl, neg_lvl))

# Baseline / confusion / accuracy
maj_lvl <- names(sort(table(train[[TARGET]]), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
baseline_acc <- mean(test[[TARGET]] == maj_lvl)

cm_xgb <- caret::confusionMatrix(pred_xgb, test[[TARGET]], positive = pos_lvl)
cm_table <- cm_xgb$table
acc_xgb <- as.numeric(cm_xgb$overall["Accuracy"])

# Macro-F1 (yardstick expects factor truth and predicted class)
eval_df <- tibble::tibble(truth = test[[TARGET]], .pred_class = pred_xgb)
mf1_xgb  <- yardstick::f_meas(eval_df, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class,
                              estimator = "macro")$.estimate

# Robust AUC: note robust_auc expects factor truth and pos-scores for pos level.
# We have numeric labels y_test (0/1), but robust_auc expects factor levels.
truth_factor <- test[[TARGET]]
auc_obj <- robust_auc(truth_factor, prob_xgb)
auc_xgb  <- auc_obj$auc
roc_best <- auc_obj$roc

# Print results
cat("=== XGBoost (direct xgb.train) — Simplified Test Results ===\n\n")
cat("Confusion Matrix:\n")
print(cm_table)
cat(sprintf("\nAccuracy: %.3f\nMacro-F1: %.3f\nAUC: %.3f\nBaseline Accuracy: %.3f\n",
            acc_xgb, mf1_xgb, auc_xgb, baseline_acc))

# Confusion heatmap (same style as before)
cm_tbl <- as.data.frame(cm_xgb$table)
ggplot(cm_tbl, aes(Prediction, Reference, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), color = "white", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#6aaed6", high = "#08306b") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(title = "Confusion Matrix — XGBoost")


```
```{r}
# ==== ROC Curve — XGBoost ====

plot(roc_best,
     main = "ROC — XGBoost",
     col = "#1f78b4",
     lwd = 3)

legend("bottomright",
       legend = sprintf("AUC = %.3f", auc_xgb),
       bty = "n")
```
